request: Develop the selected five profiles, with particular attention to Krone’s brotherhood with Draygar.

discovery.limits: Overlapping exports, edits, unrelated matches and protected material are discovery only. Selected primary quests, narrator-led rifts and compatible RP are read; no claim of full archive coverage. Raw material stays external.

decisions: Quest outcomes govern compatible RP and retrospective notes; character statements keep their speakers. Supplied framework directions do not become canon.

Krone’s brotherhood gains ordinary life, mutual rescue, restraint, praise and fear. The original pledge to Cala and gift support the later transfer to Draygar, without a biological genealogy or merger of every later weapon.
The narrator-led rift on 23 July 2026 shows Krone alive and fighting again. Earlier absence remains historical; its whole interval and final whereabouts are unresolved.

Bitoshi gains a prior purpose, practical exploration, an actual berry rescue, mistaken assumptions, an apology and later family language. Multiple deaths and returns remain distinct. Wife language and an accepted proposal do not invent a wedding date or all relationship terms.

Quake gains his own upbringing account, the shade confrontation, the young staff’s gift, a costly route choice, travel work, retreat and the post-Wrath refusal. A burial request is not a death confirmation; divine testimony and predictions remain claims.

Farkur’s actual repair and escape preparation remain beside his later confession. The narrator releases the group, but the Guardians do not restore cooperation. Later trade and supplies correct his current status without explaining a reported absence or erasing Ryvyt’s earlier experience.

Minerva’s own Olindian childhood, care and threats remain beside the observed coercion and competing explanations at the Guardians. Her later notes cannot overrule quests. The forest figures assure free will, not a definite return; her Sending reports safety without confirming a completed ritual.

Five existing player identities and all old media, source sections, chapter destinations, references and direct quotations remain. Draygar gains only links; connected Knights/Ryvyt/Gael/shop text receives narrow later-presence corrections.

Timeline dates and importance, maps, quotes, relationships, protected records, original media/261 browsing previews and the complete private payload remain unchanged. Only five directory summaries and Farkur’s full-name search alias change. No new runtime, stylesheet, dependency or pipeline stage.
